_README: The defect corpus: deliberate breaks in the merge gate's own code, each run
against every rung of the gate's tests, to show which rung notices. Run by
`scripts/ci/mutation_sweep.py --rung-report`. An escape is a finding, not a
failure: it exits 0, and on main it means a test is owed, filed as an issue.
This is not `config/mutation_gate.json`, whose cases must all be caught.
`why` is written before running the case. `aim` is the rung that should catch
it. An anchor that stops matching fails `--check-anchors` on the PR that moved
it: update the case in that change.

cases.label: scratch: a comment-only edit that no test can notice
cases.why: Write-path test of the issue filer: this case must escape.
